commands.description: Estrazione puntuale: identifica entità e concetti chiave. Per ogni elemento, riporta la citazione testuale esatta (verbatim) e spiega perché è rilevante.
Sintesi densa: elimina ripetizioni e dettagli minori. Mantieni solo i punti informativi essenziali e i passaggi decisivi.
Filtro tematico: isola e raggruppa solo le parti del testo che trattano l'argomento specifico indicato.
Analisi strutturale: individua ed estrai le singole tesi, argomentazioni o catene di ragionamento presenti.
Comparazione: analizza due o più elementi evidenziando in modo preciso somiglianze, differenze e punti di contatto.
Fusione dati: unisci più testi in un unico output coerente, eliminando i doppioni e risolvendo eventuali contrasti tra le informazioni.
Task libero: esegui qualsiasi altra operazione richiesta non specificata sopra.

sources.name: finance
sources.description: Financial and corporate documentation, such as financial statements and annual reports. This includes company information and governance (name, location, stock exchange listings, board members, executives, shareholders, auditors, and compensation policies), key financial metrics (revenue, profit/loss, debt, assets, cash reserves, EPS, dividends (with USD conversion), and operational and strategic analysis (business segments, business segments, significant events, and risk factors).

what.name: company_name
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "the full legal name of the company as disclosed in the annual report."

what.name: registered_office
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "the registered address or main office location of the company."

what.name: exchange_code
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "The code of the stock exchange where the company is listed (e.g., ASX, SUN)."

what.name: principal_activities
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "main business activities or industry classification; choose one or more from ['Mining', 'finance', 'Healthcare', 'Manufacturing', 'Technology', 'Retail', 'Energy', 'Utilities', 'Real Estate', 'Transportation', 'Agriculture', 'Telecommunications', 'Media', 'Other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. Mining || finance)."

what.name: board_members
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "profiles of board members."

what.name: executive_profiles
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "profiles of executive management team members."

what.name: revenue
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "total operating revenue recognized during the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: net_profit_or_loss
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "net profit or loss amount for the reporting period (enter a negative number for loss). Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: total_debt
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "total debt outstanding at the end of the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: total_assets
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "total assets held by the company at the end of the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: cash_reserves
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "total cash and cash equivalents held at period-end. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: net_assets
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "net asset value at the end of the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: earnings_per_share
what.definition: A "float" element with the following description "earnings per share (EPS) for the reporting period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: dividend_per_share
what.definition: A "float" element with the following description "dividends paid per share for the period. Enter a number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: largest_shareholder
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the name of the largest shareholder."

what.name: the_highest_ownership_stake
what.definition: A "float" element with the following description "the highest percentage of ownership held by a single shareholder. Enter a number, unit: percent (%)."

what.name: major_equity_changes
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "whether there were major equity changes during the period; choose one from ['Yes', 'No']."

what.name: major_events
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "type(s) of major events; choose one or more from ['M&A', 'Litigation', 'Major Contract', 'Leadership Change', 'Restructuring', 'Delisting', 'Other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. Litigation)."

what.name: bussiness_sales
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "total operating revenue from all major business lines or segments. If the document reports revenue for multiple segments separately, sum all segments to obtain the total. Enter a single number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: bussiness_profit
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "total profit contributed by all major business lines or projects. If the document reports profit for multiple segments separately, sum all segments to obtain the total. Enter a single number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: bussiness_cost
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "total cost associated with all main business lines or projects. If the document reports cost for multiple segments separately, sum all segments to obtain the total. Enter a single number. If the original currency is not USD, convert to USD according to the latest available exchange rate."

what.name: business_segments_num
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "number of business segments reported. Enter a number."

what.name: business_risks
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "main types of business risks; choose one or more from ['Market Risk', 'Credit Risk', 'Operational Risk', 'Legal/Compliance Risk', 'Environmental Risk', 'Strategic Risk', 'Other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. Credit Risk || Market Risk)."

what.name: remuneration_policy
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "executive remuneration policy type; choose only one from ['Fixed', 'Performance-based', 'Stock Option', 'Mixed', 'Not Disclosed']."

what.name: auditor
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "name of the external audit firm."
